meta.name: IonGauge
meta.title: KJLC 354 Ion Gauge Pressure
meta.description: Live OCR of a KJLC® 354 Series Ion Gauge with Integrated Controller & Display. Reads the chamber pressure shown on the front-panel display as a single floating-point value in Torr.

llm.prompt:
These photos are of the front panel of a KJLC® 354 Series Ion Gauge with Integrated Controller & Display. The display shows the current vacuum chamber pressure as a number in scientific notation (for example "1.23 E-7" or "8.50-08", meaning 1.23×10⁻⁷ Torr or 8.50×10⁻⁸ Torr).

Read the pressure value shown on the display. The unit is Torr.

Return a JSON object with a single key "pressure" mapped to the numeric pressure as a standard floating-point number (e.g., {"pressure": 1.23e-7}). Do NOT return the value as a string.

If the display is off, shows dashes or an error code, or the value cannot be read confidently from any of the provided frames, return {"pressure": null}.
